# Identify the latest original air date in the dataframe
latest_date = df['Original air date'].max()

# Filter rows where the original air date matches the latest date
latest_episodes = df[df['Original air date'] == latest_date]

# Extract the title(s) of the episode(s) with the latest air date
# Since the question asks for "the name of the last episode", we assume a single episode.
# If multiple episodes aired on the same last date, we take the first one (or all if needed).
# The question phrasing suggests a singular answer, so we take the first title.
last_episode_title = latest_episodes['Title'].iloc[0]

# Assign the answer
answer = last_episode_title
